Metadatos.descripcion: Manage your rentals and split utility bills among your tenants.

Inicio.lema: Your rentals in order, with bills split clearly.
Inicio.cuentaBorrada: Your account and all its data have been deleted. Thank you for using Inquilinus.

Registro.subtitulo: Start managing your rentals in a minute.
Registro.contrasenaAyuda: At least {minimo} characters. A sentence you'll remember works great.

Errores.importeInvalido: Enter a valid amount, for example 450 or 450.50.
Errores.diaCobroInvalido: The payment day must be between 1 and 28.
Errores.precioInicialFuturo: The price can't start in a future month.
Errores.salidaAntesDeEntrada: The move-out date can't be before the move-in date.
Errores.solape: That room is already occupied on those dates.
Errores.datosInvalidos: Some information isn't valid. Please check it and try again.
Errores.sinEstanciaAbierta: This tenant isn't living in any room right now.

Errores.cambioAntesDeEntrada: The change must be after the move-in date.
Errores.ficheroInvalido: It must be a PDF of up to 10 MB.
Errores.subidaCaducada: The upload has expired. Choose the file again.
Errores.subidaFallida: The file couldn't be uploaded. Check your connection and try again.
Errores.almacenNoConfigurado: Documents can't be uploaded right now. Please try again later.
Errores.devolucionIncompleta: For the refund, enter both the date and the amount returned.
Errores.devolucionMayor: You can't return more than the deposit.
Errores.devolucionAntesDeRecepcion: The refund can't be earlier than the date you received the deposit.
Errores.notasLargas: Notes can be at most 300 characters.
Errores.alguienViviendo: It can't be archived while someone lives there or is due to move in. Record their move-out first.
Errores.ultimaHabitacion: The property needs at least one active room.
Errores.habitacionConEstancias: This room has had tenants: archive it instead of deleting it.

Errores.sinEstanciaEnElMes: This tenant didn't live there that month.

Errores.cobroExistente: They already have a payment that month. If you removed it, restore it from “Removed payments”.
Errores.sinPrecio: A room was occupied without a price that month: give it a price first.

Panel.vacioTexto: Add a flat with its rooms and tenants, and you'll see here what you're owed and by whom.

dobleFactor.explicacion: Besides your password, we'll ask for a code from an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator…) when you sign in.
dobleFactor.explicacionActivo: When you sign in with your password we also ask for the code from your authenticator app.
dobleFactor.soloGoogle: You sign in with Google: two-step verification is handled by your Google account.
dobleFactor.pedirContrasena: For your security, confirm your password.
dobleFactor.escanear: Scan this code with your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code it shows.
dobleFactor.qrAlt: QR code to add Inquilinus to your authenticator app
dobleFactor.sinCamara: Can't scan it? Enter this key in the app:
dobleFactor.guardaCodigos: Keep these recovery codes somewhere safe. If you lose your phone, each one lets you sign in once. We won't show them again.
dobleFactor.archivoCodigos: Inquilinus recovery codes. Each one works only once.
dobleFactor.explicacionActivoEmail: When you sign in with your password we also email you a 6-digit code.
dobleFactor.cambiarMetodo: To change the method, turn it off and turn it on again with the other one.
dobleFactor.diferencia: The app is safer and works offline. The email code is simpler but protects less: if someone gets into your email, they could also get in here.
dobleFactor.activadoEmail: Two-step verification is on. Every time you sign in with your password we'll email you a code.
dobleFactor.avisoSpam: Until the app has its own domain, the code may land in your spam folder. Mark it as "Not spam" the first time.

sesiones.explicacion: If you've signed in on a device you no longer use or that isn't yours, sign out everywhere. You'll need to sign in here again too.

datos.explicacionExportar: Download a copy of all your account data as a JSON file. It doesn't include passwords or security keys.
datos.explicacionBorrar: Deleting your account permanently removes your properties, tenants, payments, bills and documents, and signs you out on all your devices.
datos.aviso: This can't be undone. If you want to keep anything, download your data first.

Inmuebles.vacioTitulo: You don't have any properties yet
Inmuebles.vacioTexto: Add your first flat with its rooms and, if you like, its tenants and expenses. It takes a few minutes.
Inmuebles.verArchivados: {n, plural, one {Show the archived property} other {Show the # archived properties}}

Asistente.nombreAyuda: Whatever you call it: “City flat”, “Beach house”…

habitaciones.explicacion: Each room has its own price. If one is empty, you cover its rent.

entero.explicacion: It's rented as a whole. If a room is empty, its rent is split among the tenants who are there.

Asistente.modalidadFija: The rental type can't be changed later.
Asistente.mesesParciales: If someone moves in or out mid-month

mes_completo.explicacion: They pay the whole month even if they aren't there every day.

prorrateo.explicacion: They only pay for the days they live in the flat.

Asistente.diaCobroAyuda: From 1 to 28. The month's payments are created on that day.
Asistente.habitacionesAyuda: Add each room with its monthly price.
Asistente.habitacionesAyudaEntero: If you rent it to one person or family, a single “room” representing the home is enough.
Asistente.desdeAntes: A tenant was already living there before this month
Asistente.desdeMesAyuda: These prices will apply from that month. You can change them later.
Asistente.inmuebleCreado: “{nombre}” has been created. You can fill in the rest now or later.
Asistente.gastosAyuda: Tick the expenses you split among your tenants. If they're included in the rent, skip this.
Asistente.gastosColor: Each expense gets its own colour so you can spot it at a glance.
Asistente.inquilinosAyuda: Add whoever lives in the flat now. You can also do it later.
Asistente.soloNombre: We only keep the tenant's name: no ID, phone or email.

Detalle.creado: Property added. You can review and complete it here whenever you like.
Detalle.precioExplicacion: It applies to that month and the following ones. Earlier months keep their price.
Detalle.salidaExplicacion: Their link will keep working for 3 months after they move out.
Detalle.fechaCambio: First day in the new room
Detalle.cambioExplicacion: The current stay ends the day before and the new one begins.
Detalle.soloNombre: We only keep the tenant's name.
Detalle.sinGastos: You don't split expenses: they're included in the rent.
Detalle.confirmarBorrar: Delete the {que}? This can't be undone.
Detalle.documentoAyuda: PDF only, up to 10 MB. The tenant can't see them and they never go through the AI.
Detalle.notasAyuda: For example, “repainting the room”. Don't include personal data.
Detalle.habitacionesArchivadas: {n, plural, one {# archived room} other {# archived rooms}}
Detalle.gastosArchivados: {n, plural, one {# archived expense} other {# archived expenses}}
Detalle.antiguos: {n, plural, one {# former tenant} other {# former tenants}}
Detalle.confirmarBorrarInquilino: Delete {nombre}? Their stays, documents and deposit will be deleted too. This can't be undone.
Detalle.confirmarAnonimizar: Delete {nombre}? They have payments or splits, so there they'll be shown as “Inquilino N” with the same amounts. Their name, documents and deposit will be deleted. This can't be undone.
Detalle.archivadoAviso: This property is archived: it's hidden from your list and doesn't generate payments. You can restore it below.
Detalle.archivarExplicacion: If you no longer rent it out, archive it: it's hidden from your list and keeps all its history. You can restore it whenever you like.
Detalle.restaurarExplicacion: It shows up in your list again with everything it had.
Detalle.borrarInmuebleExplicacion: Deleting it removes everything in it: rooms, tenants, payments, bills and documents. This can't be undone.

Cobros.generarExplicacion: Creates this month's payments for whoever lived here and doesn't have one yet.
Cobros.generados: {n, plural, one {# payment created.} other {# payments created.}}
Cobros.anadirExplicacion: If you leave the rent empty, the calculated one is used (if they lived here that month).
Cobros.asumesTuExplicacion: What nobody pays for empty rooms or unoccupied days.
Cobros.quitados: {n, plural, one {# removed payment} other {# removed payments}}
Cobros.importeExplicacion: The payment will be marked as edited.
Cobros.moverExplicacion: The payment still belongs to the same month; only the date changes.
Cobros.quitarConfirmacion: Remove this payment? It won't be shown or counted, and you can restore it.
Cobros.recalcularPagado: This payment is already collected. Recalculate it anyway? It will stay collected.
Cobros.recalcularEditado: You changed this payment by hand. Recalculate it and lose that change?
Cobros.sinEstancia: This tenant didn't live here that month, so this payment doesn't apply. Remove it?

Facturas.subirExplicacion: Choose one or more PDFs (up to 20, 10 MB each at most). Each PDF is one bill. Then you check its details and confirm it to split it.
Facturas.subirAyuda: PDF only, up to 20 at once.
Facturas.subidas: {n, plural, one {# bill uploaded.} other {# bills uploaded.}}
Facturas.rechazadas: {n, plural, one {Couldn't upload: {nombres}. It must be a PDF of up to 10 MB.} other {Couldn't upload: {nombres}. They must be PDFs of up to 10 MB.}}
Facturas.sinDatos: No details yet: the expense type, period and amount need filling in.
Facturas.descartarConfirmacion: Discard this bill? It will be deleted with its PDF.
